instruction: A cryogenics laboratory: rows of upright cryo pods with frosted glass glowing pale blue, sleeping silhouettes inside, thick insulated cables snaking across the floor, a central monitoring console with animated vitals, floor mist pooling low, specimen tanks bubbling, warning lights blinking amber, and frost crystals creeping across the pod rims.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Cryogenics Lab Interior. A cryogenics laboratory: rows of upright cryo pods with frosted glass glowing pale blue, sleeping silhouettes inside, thick insulated cables snaking across the floor, a central monitoring console with animated vitals, floor mist pooling low, specimen tanks bubbling, warning lights blinking amber, and frost crystals creeping across the pod rims. Style: cold clinical sci-fi. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
